comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
I got them from the Hidden Passage in Rome.

As the description says, your active skills will be prolonged when you're using them while sailing. Benefit of this is that this saves you some vigour on sea.

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: I just fired one of these, the actual effect is kinda useful, not huge benefit but nice to have - and lasts for 2 weeks! The bubbles look very funny. I have another 3 so I guess I'll be bubbling all summer.
